verdict.rationale: Official self-host docs state Hoppscotch Community Edition is free and open-source under the MIT License, and the public GitHub repository (github.com/hoppscotch/hoppscotch) hosts the product source. Community users independently describe it as an open-source Postman, though they also note it is 'open core', with the Enterprise Edition's features kept commercial. Missing for 10: evidence that Enterprise Edition features (SAML SSO, audit logs) are open source, and direct evidence of the LICENSE file in the repo.
